virtualbox.limitations: Apple Silicon builds are not the primary path for x86_64/i386 boot automation; use for arm64 guests only when explicitly needed.

utm.limitations: No native CLI automation is wired into this repository; use manually if needed.

qemu.limitations: x86 guests run under TCG on Apple Silicon and are slow; arm64 is supported only when the matching firmware is present.
